en: A monochrome photograph of a Byzantine-style church complex on a rocky hillside, with tall cypress trees rising beside stone fortification walls. A large arched gateway sits at the base of the hill, above a rough path, while above it stands a multi‑storey bell tower with arched openings and a domed church behind it. The landscape is mountainous in the background. At the bottom center, there is a modern printed website watermark.
